description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham is a budget hotel chain property situated on Valhalla Road in Quesnel, a service hub in BC's Cariboo region. It offers a predictable roadside overnight stop for touring cyclists moving through central BC, with direct booking available through the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program. As a franchise property, amenities may vary from brand standards and are not detailed on the corporate website for this location.
